assumptions: Contemporaneous ratios use average assets (AT_t + AT_{t-1})/2; the source does not identify the averaging dates.

Actual Earnings_{t+1} uses average assets (AT_{t+1} + AT_t)/2 only when the t+1 assets and currency are observed. A missing t+1 IBC is replaced only after a dated CRSP performance delisting in the actual t-to-t+1 window. For that replacement, I use the latest annual book-equity and asset observations dated on or before DLSTDT; when the observed t+1 balance sheet is dated after delisting, the replacement uses current-year CEQ and current-period average assets. The paper leaves the exact dates unspecified, so this is an event-date best-effort rule.

Performance-related CRSP delistings are coded as DLSTCD 500 or 520–584, following the standard Shumway classification because the paper does not enumerate codes. Annual bottom-decile ranks use the common Table 2 sample and SAS ties=mean ranking.

The Table 2 note's inclusive SI cutoff (SPI/average assets <= -0.02) governs over the equation (5) prose's strict threshold. OLS uses conventional default standard errors because no correction is reported.
